Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J23/J23nB134.xml). Recorded Sayings of the Five Houses (Selections). Yunmen Wenyan owns the retained deployment: turns the ascetic's demand live on an attendant standing at his side, not asking of speech, not asking of silence, so how will you say it, and when the monk has no words, tells him to ask back, and to the monk's question only calls a little novice by name, and when the novice answers, tells the monk he has gained a junior brother.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1394.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Duanqiao Miaolun. Duanqiao Miaolun owns the retained deployment: raises the case in hall, the ascetic's refusal of speech and silence, the World-Honored's long pause, the ascetic's praise that the cloud of confusion was opened and he entered, then verses the whole happening as throwing one's own brick into empty sky and hitting one's own head with it, plainly hurting oneself and hard to say, rubbing one's own head and going home to rest.

Occurrences.Kwic: 似金愽金。雖然如是，檢點將來，不無滲漏。今日蔡中郎或捧一尊像，請雲門安名，即向道：清淨法身毗盧遮那佛。若云謝師安名，即向道：下坡不走，快便難逢。師云：裴公捧像，黃檗安名，冷地看來，如大家教新婦相似，直是好笑，笑須三十年。妙喜既不能坐斷，未免隨例顛倒，喚作清淨法身毗盧遮那佛。周人以栢，殷人以栗。舉外道問佛：不問有言，不問無言。世尊良久，外道讚嘆云：世尊大慈大悲，開我迷雲，令我得入。外道去後，阿難問佛：外道有何所證，而言得入？世尊云：如世良馬，見鞭影而行。雪竇云：邪正不分，過由鞭影。妙喜云：邪正兩分，正由鞭影。師云：欲識邪正不分麼，誰是外道？誰是世尊？欲識邪正兩分麼，世尊自世尊，外道自外道。此是天寧見處，一任諸方貶剝。舉：僧
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1420.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chushi Fanqi. Chushi Fanqi owns the retained deployment: raises the case with Xuedou's ruling that the fault lay in the whip-shadow and Dahui's that the rightness lay in the whip-shadow, then asks who wants to see right and wrong undivided, who then is the ascetic and who the World-Honored, and who wants them two, the World-Honored being simply the World-Honored and the ascetic the ascetic, calling this his own place seen and letting the schools devalue it as they will.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB173.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Wuming of Shouchang. Wuming Huijing owns the retained deployment: names the matter the empty valley passing sound and the vacant hall rehearsing hearing, then asks whether the World-Honored's long silence and Zhaojue's granted staff are the same or different, ruling that whoever checks this out makes the ascetic a buddha, and failing that the buddha is the ascetic, capping it with dragons flying and phoenixes dancing, truly strange, no good for the western monk's blue eyes.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin. Feiyin Tongrong owns the retained deployment: rules over the case that the World-Honored's long silence filled the ditches and dams, the ascetic's entering an old scar taking moxa, and checked out each earns a pair of straw sandals, the point being to set the whole world doubting, then turns the demand on himself, that were someone to ask him today the same refusal of speech and silence he would only raise one finger, and asks the assembly whether that is same as the World-Honored or different.

Senses.Explanation: The demand that rules out both answers in advance, and the long silence that answered it. Yunmen Wenyan turns the demand live on an attendant standing at his side, asking not of speech, not of silence, so how will you say it, and when the monk has no words, tells him to ask back, and to the monk's question only calls a little novice by name, and when the novice answers, tells the monk he has gained a junior brother, Duanqiao Miaolun raises the case and verses the whole happening as throwing one's own brick into empty sky and hitting one's own head with it, plainly hurting, hard to tell, rubbing one's own head and going home to rest, Chushi Fanqi, after weighing Xuedou's fault lies in the whip-shadow against Dahui's rightness lies in the whip-shadow, asks who wants to see right and wrong undivided, who then is the ascetic and who the World-Honored, and who wants them divided, the World-Honored being simply the World-Honored and the ascetic the ascetic, calling this the place he stands and letting the schools devalue it as they will, and Wuming Huijing names the matter the empty valley passing sound and the vacant hall rehearsing hearing, asking whether the World-Honored's long silence and Zhaojue's granted staff are the same or different, for whoever checks it out makes the ascetic a buddha, and failing that, the buddha is the ascetic, dragons flying and phoenixes dancing, truly strange, no good for the western monk's blue eyes. Feiyin Tongrong rules that the long silence filled the ditches and dams, the ascetic's entering an old scar taking moxa, and checked out, each earns a pair of straw sandals, the point being to make the whole world doubt, and that were someone to ask him today the same refusal of speech and silence, he would only raise one finger, same as the World-Honored or different, Tian'an Sheng after his own roaring about old paper and rotten vines declares he has sixty staff-strokes in three shares, one share for the ascetic, who should not have swallowed the cheat flat and white, one for the World-Honored, who should not have handed out winter-melon seals so easily, and one for himself, who should not have put the buddhas and patriarchs on the scales, with Ananda told to go stand at the World-Honored's right hand, and Wanru Tongwei reads the case's two edges, that silent to the ascetic the ascetic entered, and speaking to Ananda, Ananda blanked, which is just to say the eastern patch-robed monks fall short of the western ascetic.
